title: Recent Wage Growth and Consistent Core PCE Inflation
source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Bureau of Economic Analysis, and Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta; author's calculations.
note: ECI is the Employment Cost Index. ECI, Wages and Salaries, Private Workers Excluding Incentive Paid Occupations and Average Hourly Earnings, Private Workers are extended prior to March 2006 using ECI, Wages and Salaries, Private Workers, and Average Hourly Earnings, Private Production and Nonsupervisory Workers, respectively. *6-month change for all series except for Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker (12-month change).
